Replace all surrounding ground, grass, wildflowers, paths, dirt, loose pebbles, every ground shadow and cut-off peripheral objects with EXACTLY solid RGB(0,255,0), hexadecimal #00ff00, at every background pixel. No gradient, texture, noise, lighting or colour variation in the green. All original green sheet gutters remain precisely unchanged. Gaps among retained branches and roots become the same pure green. Preserve the existing hand-drawn painted 2D look exactly. No new objects, no movement, no resizing, no changed silhouette, no halo or blur. Pure opaque green, not transparency.
